data.long_meaning: Jivanya is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'jivan', meaning 'life'. The name signifies the goddess of life, and is believed to bring vitality and energy to the one who bears it. In Hindu mythology, Jivanya is often associated with the goddess Durga, who represents the power and energy of life. The name Jivanya carries the meaning “Goddess of Life” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jivanya usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of life and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Jivanya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Life.”
